review_description: Smooth process, very responsive sales team, punctual, and excellent pricing.
Very straightforward process. The install was quick and the team were polite and very tidy. Cleantech followed up to make sure everything went well.

CTS were very easy to deal with. They were very competitive with their price. All my questions were answered promptly. My requested changes to the system were done without any hassles. They started dot at 8am and by 2pm the install was completed. All in all a great team to deal with.

Clean Technology Services were one of the installers referred to by Solar Quotes. The one thing that definitely caught my eye was their customer service and their eagerness to explain to the customer each and every detail every step of the way. They weren't hesitant to answer a few of the tough questions too. They were one of the very few installers who do not subcontract as well, which is a huge win in my eyes.On the install day, they were punctual and reached on time, were very polite and went about their way. I went to talk to the supervisor a couple of times to understand what was happening and he was very polite and friendly and spared some time to answer my questions.They cleaned up after themselves and also post install handled all the paperwork to get the solar being recognised by the energy retailer. They even helped me with the usage of the iSolarCloud app that shows details of the solar generation and how much is being sent to the grid or how much is being consumed from the grid. They even sent a QA person to review the install quality and work. He rated them highly too.Would recommend Clean Technology Services to anyone looking to install a Solar Panel System in Victoria.

That sounds like a fantastic experience! Here’s a refined version of your review with improved clarity and flow:From the initial quote to installation, working with Aaron was a great experience. He was incredibly informative about the solar panels and showed a lot of patience, especially since I knew very little about solar energy. I combined what I learned from SolarQuotes with the valuable information Aaron provided to confidently make my decision to move forward.The installation was originally estimated to take two days, but the team managed to complete everything in just one. One of the tradespeople even stayed back late to ensure everything was correctly installed and ready for inspection.Overall, it was a seamless and positive experience!
They pretty much did everything. Which was good.
price seemed very affordable , quick service and very friendly and helpful workers
As l said they were a professional company to work with.

Quoting process was quick and easy. Price was competitive so we signed solar vic contract 6 months ago while the house is in final stages of built. As at now, we have waited 2 months for CTS to confirm an install date. Account manager that used to be responsive is now longer responsive- he is not returning my calls or text….Overall, I am not sure if they intend to install. What a mess! Competitive price won’t help if you don’t intend to meet your contracts!
Excellent communication; fast installation & follow up phone call. Have recommended to family and friends.

CTS provided the best quote for solar with decent reputation. I went with 10.3kw jinko solar pannel and sungrow inverter.The communication throughout the process was good, and installers seemed to know what they are doing.I can't comment on the after sales service but so far so happy with the service.
As above , install with 19 panels done by 2pm. Good communication and neat work (I looked in ceiling.

Installers were prompt on time as discussed.They arrived at my home with a group of 5 installers and put in a huge effort to get 13.2kw of panels installed by lunchtime.Jason installed the inverter neatly in my garage and did a good job of tidying up afterwards.I am very happy with the outcome.
Team very friendly, Good price, fast response and good customer service.

From the moment I've requested some quotes, Ron was first to make contact, and information was supplied efficiently and to the point. As per my request communication was clear and changes were made without any issues.Once installation was given the go-ahead, process was seamless. Installation team was very efficient and spent the necessary time to install the system professionally. They were punctual and no time wasted during the process. On top of it the team were friendly and explained all my questions carefully.Few days after the install the system was up and running and all paperwork quickly completed and submitted.I will definitely recommend them to my friends and not bother spending hours comparing !

The quoting process was simple and efficient with prompt replies to my emails and texts.  The sales rep was happy to explain all things i asked of them and they were also very flexible to include the removal of the old system.  The installation guys were effective, polite, punctual and very respectful.  The checking post install happened the following day and I was on the grid that day.   Very content and have now referred them to family and friends and now in the process of getting a quote for my mums home.
Easy quoting, good quality installation and friendly customer service. Got a 10kw system.

Spoke to Ron who sorted everything out quickly and wasn't pushy at all. System was the same or better as what was being offered by my other 2 quotes and the price was competitive. All the rebates and grants also sorted quickly. The installation was straightforward and was done within a week of all the rebates being approved and everything is working well.

Cheapest quote by far for identical panels and inverter, based on other reviews gave them a go. Excellent installation quality. So no issues at all. Complete set up and generating solar later than day! Sparky helped me set up the app to monitor all solar into house and into the grid as well, best time to use and everything! Grid connection organised by company as well.
Great price, customer service and professionalism. Swift installation. Couldn’t be happier.

Value for money.  Knowledgeable sales person , Ronn. They quoted the same product as another company but their price was lower.Just got it installed today & lo ‘n’ behold, the guy running around doing the dirty work is the boss ! Lovely person , showed me the app & all.My advice, spend time & do research.

From start to finish, the solar installer managed the process smoothly and competently with no hiccup.  Their price was competitive and demonstrated value for money. They were professional and helpful in providing solar design, and clear and detailed quotation, and in organising grid connection after the installation. They had a dedicated team to complete the installation and commissioning punctually, professionally and efficiently. They helped to set up the inverter's app for solar monitoring. I am happy that my solar system is up and running to save energy.

Aaron (sales team) was excellent.  The initial call brought together all the solar research I've done and he was able to quickly turnaround quotes for the system, especially since i requested a few options.Jason and the instalation team we extremely thorough and the teamed up to install the solar panels at the same time as installing the invertor.  Installation was done during the day.The team arranged all the 3rd party red tape (such as connecting to the grid) and so I have had to do almost nothing other than let them.

The entire process from beginning to end was stress free. Great communication with the company and the installer turned up on-time on the day of installation.Roof top panels and the inverter were professionally installed. Site was also properly cleaned up when they complete the installation job.They deal with all paperwork, including supplying all the required documentation to my electricity retailer, so I would say their customer service is excellent.Overall, I am very happy with the outcome.
Salesman was very accommodating in his pricinginstallers were thorough and competent

Quoting process was very easy with the 3 companies quoting from my preferences and Google mapsInstallation process was very good. They had a cancellation so we’re able to install 48 hours after I had decided on their services.

Positive experience from the beginning to the end. Installation went nice and smooth, installers were professional and efficient. Jason answered all questions we had . Commission of the system took place not long after installation.At this stage system works well and we start benefiting from lower bills.
Sales person was good and polite when there were couple of back and forth on the design.Installers were pretty good.

Ron and his team were helpful and took an appreciated 'no fuss' approach. The quotes provided were very reasonable and installation on the day was a breeze.The only slight disappointment is that a few of the panels had to be positioned south-facing on the day to account for the roofing despite the quote indicating they would all fit on the north and west.

Helpful throughout.I would have appreciated being given a copy of Jinko's Modern Slavery statement given their operation in the Uyghur Autonomous Region of China,, but obtained this for myself via their website.

Maddy helped me get the best price and recommended the right solution for me. Good crew, came out on a day it was drizzling and understandably couldn’t work on our colourblind roof safely. Came back early the next day and knocked it off by lunch time. Also did some other electrical work, was a bit rushed but mostly happy with the result especially considering it was the cheapest quote around! Thanks Maddy and the team.
Maddy provided exceptional service from the start and provided excellent communication right up until the installation.Will be going back to arrange a battery with Maddy in the near future.

Highly recommend installation was smooth friendly staff and installers they know their product well. Cleaned up after themselves great communication and knowledge from the sales rep Maddy to all the installers at my property.Have no hesitation to use again if l moved houses and have recommended to friends.

14/2/24 Update: I left a poor review which you will see below, but since, Maddy has made genuine attempt to rectify my concerns and disappointment. I can say that the resolution provided was adequate for me to give another review with a more positive outcome. I feel confident that if dealing with them again, my need’s would be addressed with reasonable and fair options.Original review: Sales and quoting was fine maddy was very helpful but installation was when things went downhill l was quoted for a Sungrow inverter and a Goodwe was installed:( when the inspector came to go over the system two faults were found one was fixed today 6 weeks after inspection also the system wasn’t putting power back into the grid because it was set up improperlyI received my first power bill and realised that my electricity supplier was not aware that we had grid connection so I’m out of pocket at least 6 weeks of grid input at this stage my app is saying $85 which I think should be reimbursed by clean energy!!I would appreciate if you would follow up with me what your action is to my dissatisfaction.Thanks Joe.
End to end process was seamless. Maddy patiently answered all questions and assisted with the process
Maddy and his team were very easy to work with. Installation was prompt and hassle-free. Everything set-up within a week.
Everything went smoothly. No issues whatsoever. Friendly service and price unmatched. No deposit needed.

Selected this company from the 3 companies provided, provided them with my house plans and lock in the installation 3 months out.On day of installation the team arrived to the installation of our selected solar panel system and after an hour later, packed up and left, with no system being installed.They told my wife that our roof was dusty and that she had to pressure wash clean it.Asked for manager to call me ba k, been a week and still no response.What a waste of time.
Good experience overall. competitive pricing and great service. Maddy is easy to talk to and always happy to help.Worth installing, already seeing a difference in power bills

Maddy has been very helpful in answering all questions I have in a polite manner and not pushing to get a sale. The installation was carried out in a professional manner, the technicians are polite, punctual, and they took all the rubbish and broken roof tiles with them, so much appreciated. Very happy with Sungrow and Jinko, they work as expected.

The quote and following sales process was friendly without being pushing and giving me time to decide.Installation was friendly, polite and punctual plus they cleaned everything up before they left.Service was excellent organised Inspection and as for the grid connection I am still waiting for powercor toconnect. But everything was organised by Clean Technology.

The installers were on time, courteous and kept me informed of the process of installing the panels etc. They organised inspections for a couple of days later. Excellent service and would recommend Clean Technology

Maddy was really instrumental in making this Solar System a real one. He helped me on every step. The end installation was quite tidy and done on the agreed time. I really appreciate the professionalism of the Clean Technology.

Very transparent sales/quoting process. Maddy helped with all of my questions in a very patient manner. The installation was done very quickly, and Clean Technology Services not only took care of all the administrative aspects but also gave me good advice on next steps.

Used solar quotes to get quotes from 5 different companies including clean technology services.Ron called and was very charismatic, explained things clearly and mentioned they don't use sub-contractors which i wasnt clear on how the industry worked. Quote was competitively priced so went with them.Installation day was booked in fast and not a long wait time, Jason the main electrician was nice and explained things clearly helped setup app and all.When separate independent inspector came to sign off on the work he mentioned that he never has problems with signing off this companies jobs, and also mentioned that they dont use subcontractors which is a plus, after talking to inspector about pricing i got he said i got a sharp deal which is comforting. Inspector also said sungrow was a great and reliable brand.Now organising quote to get my parents house done also.

The Company has been helpful . The installers were friendly and professional and seemed to do a good job and gave some  good advice as to the best positioning of the solar panels. Jason was a very good team leader and very helpfulThey only use their in house installers (no outside contractors) which is a requirement that i was looking for. I had a quote for the exact same system from another Company which was nowhere near what I paid, over a Thousand dollars more
Friendly and helpful company to work with for our solar installation.
By far the cheapest quote, both sales and installer where helpful with questions and install was booked within the week of all the paperwork being completed

I contacted 5 companies via email. By the following Monday Morning  I had been contacted by 4 of them by phone, and had quotes by that afternoon. All offering the same brand or similar of panels and invertor.The Team at Clean Tech Service had great communication from start to finish and were flexible with providing quotes for different brands. Once the go ahead was given, the panels were installed the following week, with independent electrical inspection completed the week after and sent to power company. Such a smooth process all organised by them. Price is ultra competitive as they have their own team of electricians and installers, so no contractors. 5 star review  from me.

By far the most competitive pricing amongst the quotes received. Quotation process went relatively straight forward and Ron was very easy to deal with. Installation was scheduled and completed in a timely and professional manner. Customer service was great too.

Ridiculously cheaper than other competitors. Knowledgeable and helpful. Speedy turn around. Very happy. Technicians were clean and quick. Organised the whole connection process (I just had to confirm it with my solar provider).
Ron and Jimmy were helpful with quote and rebate process. Fantastic, punctual and efficient installers and electrician.Organised the grid and metre reconfiguration after the install.
Very competitive pricing, quote perfectly met expectations. Installation was punctual, clean, and the workers did their job earnestly. Grid connection was organised soon after inspection.
Overall good experience. Went through full process.  Identified we needed upgraded circuit board and upgraded on the installation day. Fairly easy process Overall.

Clean Technology Services were one of three providers I spoke to. All providers were able to answer any questions I had and the quotes were all within the same price range and similar recommendations for panels and the inverter. Ultimately, my decision to go with Clean Technology came down to when they were able to install the system. The installation occurred on the date allocated, was trouble free. Excellent service provided by the team at Clean Technology.

Good experience all the way through from the quoting process to the final installation.Installation was done with a minimum of fuss by a great team of workers.Would absolutely recommend clean technology services to anyone interested in getting a solar installation.
Easy from start to finish. Sales person very polite and installation guys very professional. All mess cleaned once finished & explanation on how it works.

Received 3 quotations all recommended by Solar Quotes and i must credit them all for good customer service. The deciding factor was the price. Clean Technology provided the cheapest for the same brand panels and inverter.Installation had no issue, in fact it was excellent. Before and after sales service was commendable.Happy with Clean Technology and will happily recommend them!

I went with CTS after the 2 quotes I got automatically because of the massive price difference. First quote was $6200 out of pocket, second quote was $5300 out of pocket and CTS was $3700 out of pocket. All of them were for very similar hardware (inverter and panels)I wasn't sure if the installation quality or service would be worse because its cheaper, but to my surprise, everything was top notch. Excellent installation and after sales service.
Great communication, punctual, great customer service and tidy installation. Electrician agreed to install inverter in garage when I expressed my concerns of having inverter outside
Clear fast installation quick punctual they were there every time for every question and help me
From the first day it was friendly and professional and informative. The solar was installed in less than a month I am glad I had a business with clean energy technology very happy with my experience

Ron from CTS was very nice over the phone and provided me with an quote that had great value compared to other companies.Installation experience was smooth with no dramas. Installer actually found a broken tile and fixed it for me.Post-installation, all documents were emailed to me and inspector was arranged promptlyOverall experience was great. Would recommend this vendor

Very happy with the experience from when Ron first rang to the help on the day with the installation. Highly recommend solar quotes as a starting point and the range of choices in the companies that followed me up. Overall extremely pleased with the Company we chose to do the job.

We chose Clean Technology Services from the list provided by Solar Quotes. From the start we had good follow up and quick responses to questions, including process for application of state rebate. The quote was clear and readily adapted to include our choice of inverter. Technical staff and installers were both helpful in relation to optimal location of the panels. Installation, inspection and connection to the grid was straightforward and everything was up and running quickly.
I found the sales person and owner very helpful and direct.  It was very personalised.They were also patient as I deepened my understanding of what I needed to know.

The sales/ quoting process was quick and simple. The company was happy to provide multiple quotes for different systems and answer any queries we had.The installation team were great. Arrived on time and cleaned after they were done. Also took the time to set up the consumption monitor app.Customer service was great. Always happy to have a chat and followed up the day after installation to make sure all had gone well. Details were forwarded to the regulator for grid connection, which happened a week after the install.Very happy with the whole process and the service Clean Technology provided.

From my first contact with Ron at Clean Technology until the whole process was complete I was impressed with the entire team  for their polite and helpful service.  They organised everything from start to finish, and the job was completed within a week of receiving the quote. They saved me thousands on the same quality system that I was quoted on by another company, and I even got 6 extra panels from Clean Technology. I would highly recommend them.

The entire process was well managed. Installation was straight forward and the the installers polite and knowledgable. They managed the end to end process and it all went smoothly. Paying on completion was great. A bit more information up front on the end to end process would've been beneficial.
Jason and his team were very professional in providing a range of different quotes for different set of solar panels/invertors and they were punctual in installing the device.
Very happy with install - the system has been working really well so far. I recommend going for the bigger unit if you can fit it.
Clean Technology was easy to deal with and provided the best option for our circumstances, considering our budget and how long we plan to live in the house. No fuss, fast and tidy.
Solarquotes offered the right guidance in narrowing down on the right installer and brands. Clean Technology Services offered the best quote and quality pre-sales and installation service.
Customer service was great and installation was excellent would definitely recommend this company..

Starting from receiving the quotation till the installation, my experience was excellent while dealing with CTS. The system was designed as per my requirements and installed on the promised date without any issues. I was provided with a couple of options which helped me make an informed decision about the overall system. The installers were up to the mark and did the whole thing in around 4 hrs. Great experience overall.

CTS were a pleasure to deal with. Ron called me the same day I submitted an enquiry, and I had the quote not long after. The quote was very reasonable and the service was fantastic.On the day of the installation the technicians arrived and finished when they said they would and everything went smoothly. They were all pleasant.CTS took care of everything and the whole process was very easy. I wouldn't hesitate to recommend them.

Very efficient company from the quote to installation and following up on grid connection.It started with the very friendly and knowledgble sales person who has answered all my queries and explained the differences of different products.Their in house Installation team is beyond professional.  Team of 3 came in time as scheduled and completed everything before 2pm. Polite, friendly, careful and considered. No fuss no mess, no holes in the walls/ roof. Since I have never dealt with solar before I had few questions which was explained to me with patience and professionalism.  They are so friendly and working as a team for customer satisfaction.Sales person followed up after installation to make sure am happy with everything. Withing 3 weeks of installation my system    smoothly running and sending energy back to the grid. Ready for summer savingsThanks team.Would happily recommend them
To simply put it Tshring at Clean Technology Services made the process sim like a breeze, from quote to installation Clean Technology Services was perfect.

I am very happy with the system the team installed. I discussed my options with Ron, he came up with a good price for some good kit, and Jimmy was arranging the install and was great, and Jason the installer and electrician was just great. Really friendly, easy going people, all work is done in house and greatly impressed. Wanted to get Solar for a while and finally took the plunge and felt like i made the right decision with the right company and right kit. thank you Jason,Jimmy,Ron for making it easy. the price was right and it went smoothly

Ron, was really easy to talk to and answered all of my questions. He offered to help me with the application for the solar rebate and loan, but I was able to do that myself.Jason (the Electrician) and the Installers were really lovely guys. They even went to the trouble of asking for my neighbour's permission to park in front of their unit.They were not only punctual and extremely tidy, but I was also able to have a joke with them, as they cleaned up.Again, they answered all of the questions I asked, even though they were busy trying to get the job done.They sent everything through for the grid connectionThey made the whole experience easy and seemless. I would (and have done already) recommend them to my friends

Very happy with clean technology services. Good value for value- compared prices with other companies and realized prices were way cheaper than others.Installation was great. Came at scheduled time. After the installation, cleaned up everything and no mess was left. Staff was informative and friendly.Waiting for inspector in 2 weeks time to check everything. Apart from that, happy with Solar Company that i chose!
The installation was fast and the installer was very informative. The quoting person was helpful and followed up with all the queries that I had.
Made everything easy, installation well done and kept me informed all along

Easy to deal with, clear on what was being provided and when, easy process, didn't have to do anything but pay. Installed with no fuss, and thought went I to the best location for inverter and panel locations.

SolarQuotes provided 2 contacts - Ronnie from Clean Technology got in contact with me straight away to talk shop.Ronnie asked for house details - gave me info and prices - I asked for a couple days to think over - then accepted the quote.No issues, no hassles, easy as - Ronnie offered his assistance to complete the online applications for rebates if needed and advised me what documents I needed uploaded ready to go for the application which saved time.Application done and approved within 48 hours - Ronnie contacted me to organise installation which was a 4-6 week wait due to Covid-19 and backlog of other customers bookings - no worries - waited ages for solar - what was another couple weeks (no-ones fault).Installation day - Jason the electrician arrived early and got set up - gave him access to the back yard and he and his team were able to drive up and around the back of our house to make it easier for installing all the panels and equipment without much lifting and heaving.Over all the installation took 6 hours to complete - the guys were polite and courteous throughout - any mess / rubbish was cleaned up after installation - it even rained (showered) during the install and there was no complaining but knuckling down to get the job done.From start to finish - from Ronnie to Jason - everyone involved was polite and happy - no issues - no worries - a great company to get my solar installed.Ronnie even stopped in to see how the install was going - gave me some cards - which I have already passed on to friends who are looking to install solar and complimented this company on a job well done.I would recommend this company to install solar on your house.

I have recently had an VicSolar Audit done on my install and the technician was very impressed with the install of the system. Very well done.The system was a fantastic price, the sales team are not pushy and they left the site perfectly clean.I am so impressed I recommend to everyone I know.

Sales / quote process, great thank you.Customer Service grid connections, also greatInstallation:I may be just a little picky but when the installers came the electrician noticed there was some shade from a tree and recommended moving 10 of the 20 panels from North facing to East facing, the original drawings were for 10 north facing and 10 west facing because of the size of my roof.I thanked them for this and they went ahead and installed 50% east and 50% west.Once they left i have kept an eye on the solar panels and noticed the shade moved, of course it did!, what made it worse the shade from the tree covers the east panels they advised.  i am someone that listens to the so called experts and would have thought when they told me to move them, i would follow there advice.On another note the installers were very messy and left odds and ends all over the place.  They did tell me it was their last job as with Covid they were being let off due to lack of demand, and the Perth WA office was closing and only having the Melbourne office only.I know this website vets the companies so i hope they stay in business incase anything goes wrong as i trusted this website also to give me a solid company
The best service from start to finish excellent team workBig thanks to Jigme and his team 100% serviceRecommended to anyone with theClean Technology Sevices

I was looking for solar since January 2020, I got more than 20 quotes, very happy that i found this company.Sales went very well. I noticed the ad on Facebook, asked a question and got fast respond from Jigme, was not pushing to sell or fast forward any step of the process, which give me the confidence to close the deal. Fair price!On the day of the installation the guys were on time, looked after my roof and didn't do any damage. Very good team work, fast and tidy. The electrician Dominic did a great job, show and helped me to connect to wifi inverter. Finished the job and cleaned up.Good customer service, organised inspection and grid connection, any time you call they got time to listen and answer to you.Highly recommend the company!

Great advice on  system to suite our needs.Basically very similar to other companies but price was just slightly better.When it came to installation. The installers didn't have the appropriate tool to remove old system.4 days later returned to install.Went well until there was damage cause to ceiling by electrician.Company was very quick to get professional out to repair.Good follow up and hand on system operation and setting up Wi-Fi connection.Would recommend everyone has an accident now and then and company was so apoplectic for ceiling damage.

Sales process wasnâ€™t â€˜salesyâ€™. There was no home visit but sent a photo of the switchboard which identified a switchboard upgrade was required.Installation was smooth. Panel configuration was adjusted on the day with no issues. Electrician had a few difficulties deciding what to do with the switchboard but sorted it out. There were a few difficulties getting the inverter app connected but I sorted that out.Customers service was good throughout the process.
Happy with service from beginning to end - everything was very prompt and helpful
Quick and prompt with quotation. Was able to install within the week.

One of the most responsive and quickest companies to bother doing a site visit before quoting.- Having a 45 degree pitch roof proved very difficult and actually took 2 failed attempts before finally getting it done on the 3rd.- Could have easily chosen to give up and leave it for others to try do but were persistent and got there in the end.- Fit the panels neat and tidy and used 350W Jinko panels to get the system up to 6.3KW- Very tidy and neat installation- Highly recommended and provided a wonderful service- Quotes varied from $3000 to $15,000 for the same 6.6Kw install- Did not slag off other companies and had very efficient and nice automated systems & processes.

The sales quoting was good, however, they could have covered the shading issues on roof in the quote. I had to get them after getting a few quotes from others.The smart meter was not configured properly and they had to send the electrician again. Customer service has been good overall.

This company was a delight with which to work. I missed out on the 2018/19 Victorian Government rebate as it closed early. This company waited patiently for the new tranche to open in 2019 and emailed to let me know how to proceed. I had a few problems with the rebate process but Clean Technology Services answered my queries in a timely manner (even though it wasnâ€™t really their area of expertise as the process had changed). Clean Technology Services set an installation date and adhered to it. They were punctual and professional. It took about one week for our system to be hooked up to our energy provider and the grid. The company patiently showed me how to use the Fronius app (love it, am addicted). I thought our system was excellent value; 21 Jinko panels and a Fronius inverter. With the Government rebate and STCs, we were out of pocket $2,770. Not bad for a 6.6 kWh system.
Excellent. One word says everything. No need for 10 words.

We had 6.6kW of Risen panels and a 3-Phase 5kW Goodwe inverter installed. It would be hard to find the same products for a lower price. I was quite skeptical until I checked out the reviews on SolarQuotes. Actually, I was still skeptical. As far as sales was concerned, we asked and they delivered. The cost of the job was as quoted (though we did spend $50 at the scrap yard for replacement tiles before the install). The installers were friendly and polite and their sparky Daryl put up with us asking questions. The workmanship was pretty tidy though slightly scrappy with our switchboard (it was already pretty cramped before the install). After sales support was a little lacking. We have had regular inverter trips since the install. Tashi did come out to check the inverter settings. We did, in the end, discover that the fault was high grid voltage. So not the installers fault but we did have to do a bit of investigation ourselves. Western Power is now helping us fix the problem. So, if you're on a budget and don't need hand holding - go for it!

From requesting a quote to completed install producing electricity was less than 2 weeks. The price was excellent 6.6kw fronius 3 phase with Risen mono perc for less than 4k. Install was ok, and only comment is they could clean up a bit better and make the install a bit neater. My panels aren't visible from the street, but I wouldn't be too impressed with different rail lengths protruding beyond the panels or with the bracket accidently installed and still left in the roof away from the panels or the silicone gun still on the roof. Other than that, great to deal with and highly recommended.

Clean Technology Services Installed 6.6kw Solar System at my home as on 17/02/2019. from beginning they saying that you not have to do anything just fill up some form and give to us. We will complete all the formalities with Synergy.Now till date (11/03/2019) they not completed formalities with Synergy and My Synergy Account showing Pending Status for Renewable Energy.When I ask Synergy, they saying Your Solar Installer have to Submit some documents or not submitted application properly.When I ask Clean Technology, they saying we did.Now I became sandwich between this two.When I checked Renewable Energy Application submitted by solar Company with Synergy, it showing remarks Name, Surname, Contact Number Not provided.

Tshering is the most honest and reliable person to do business with. We have now purchased 2 solar units from him over the last 2 years and have another 7 family members and friends who have also dealt with Clean Technology Services having purchased solar units for each of their houses. Tshering is very knowledgable in relation to the products and has a wonderful team in support who install the systems. I have no hesitation in recommending Tshering, clean Technology Services and their products.

We have had our system (5kW Fronius + Q Cell Panels 6.6kW) in for about 5 days now and been getting in excess of 45kWh a day!! Very happy with performance.We wanted a north and west panel layout and had several installers come to our house. We had limited space on the north and were either told it could not be done or was going to cost another $150 to get someone to check if it was possible.Tshering from Clean Technology Services were the only company to send an installer to our house, free of charge, to get up on the roof and measure up to make sure they could do what they promised.Initially we had a problem with high grid voltage and Tshering again come out to our place on a weekend and altered some inverter settings, now the system is producing to its maximum.No other company quote could match the Fronius + Q Cell system price offered by Clean Technology Services and their after sales service has been great. Already, happily referred a couple more customers their way.The whole experience was very easy from start to finish. ??????????
System performs well but quality assurance and site supervision was sadly lacking.  Roof sheets damaged and hot water relay still not operational.
